content.value: ldentify the following pairs of events as statistically dependent or independent. (10)
(i) Taking a cab home and finding your favorite movie on cable.
(ii) The takeover of a company and a rise in the price of its stock.
(i)The life-span of the current presidents of USA and Bangladesh.
(iv) Purchasing a car and then purchasing a coat.
(v) Driving at night and falling asleep at the wheel.

:(b) Assume 10% of people have a certain disease. A test gives correct diagnosis (10) with probability 0.8 (i.e. if the person is sick), the test will be positive with probability 0.8, but if the person is not sick, the test will be positive with probability 0.2. A random person from the population has tested positive for the disease. What is the probability that he is actually sick?
